title: Why British Feet Keep Growing
hook: Your feet are changing shape, and your waistline is a big part of why.
closing: Your shoes aren't shrinking. You're outgrowing them, so check your size before you buy.
question: What shoe size do you wear?

segments.say: In the 1970s, the average British man wore a size 8 shoe. Now his feet have grown two full sizes.
It's not just length. About two in three women say their feet got wider as adults.
Podiatrists blame body size. Two in three adults in England are overweight, and extra weight spreads the foot.
